title: Ozito PXC 18V Brushless Chainsaw & Radio 2.5Ah Kit PCSRK-1820 $199 Delivered @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: Ozito PXC 18V Brushless Chainsaw & Radio 2.5Ah Kit PCSRK-1820 $199 Delivered @ Bunnings

[michael9865] I have the EGO chainsaw, which is awesome better than most petrol ones I've used in the past, not sure how ozito would compare if worth having as a backup
[BestTechAdvisor] The Ozito is 18V while the EGO is 56V. The Ozito will be good for bushes and small trees, but it wouldn't compete with a petrol chainsaw - not even close.
Source: I have the 18V Ryobi and a chainsaw ticket.
[Zerosignal] Yup I picked one of these up after this just for small (but annoying) stuff around the house.
[Matrix6] They've changed the price to $349 for me, it was at $199 just 5minutes before…😭
EDIT: Came back to 199, but I can't get pass checkout. Once I confirm payment, it loops back to the cart.
[JumpingUnicorns] Still shows $199 for me, might not be all stores
[brenwildman] …timber up to 140mm diameter = utterly useless compared to a $5 bush/bow saw
[morebunnings] I got the dual battery ozito chainsaw a few weeks ago. I hate it. Keeps stopping mid cut. Constantly. Chain Oil, Chain Sharpening, Fresh batteries, nothing helps it just keeps stopping mid cut. Unless its <100mm branch. It also over heats the batteries if you use it for a bit. Cant charge the batteries for ~30min until they have cooled down.
I had a electric chorded chainsaw that I loved. Will probably get one of those for larger cuts.
[morebunnings] Yeah. Didn't think it would make much of a difference. Eg. My 18v drill does most stuff my 240v drill does but the 36v chainsaw is massively underpowered compared to the 240v chainsaw.
[Horacio] And once the shock jocks have you outraged, just fire up the chainsaw
[AussieMon] Was just thinking that! The radio is listed online for $199 - I wouldn’t pay that myself but this is a pretty good deal with the extra pieces.
[paulaus] Had a couple of these chainsaws and both of them stripped the thread on the chain cover bolt. And I didn't cross thread them.
[topherboi] Thanks OP, was in the market for a chainsaw but this is much better value.
[shap08] see how long this price lasts, buy now cancel later IMO
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Oh hell yea i was going to buy the radio for 199 this is a no brainer!!
[Clear] This is eligible for the double Flybuys points offer that ends today (targeted).
[pvl] Survival kits for emergencies when people start stockpiling groceries
[Brick50] Bunnings vary pricing depending on store, commonly with timber and other products like that. surprised they are doing it on power tools also
